business_summary: Matrix Service Company provides engineering, fabrication, construction, and maintenance services to support critical energy infrastructure and industrial markets in the United States, Canada, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Storage and Terminal Solutions, Utility and Power Infrastructure, and Process and Industrial Facilities. The Storage and Terminal Solutions segment offers engineering, procurement and construction (EPC), repair, and maintenance and fabrication services for liquid, cryogenic, and refrigerated storage and terminal facilities supporting energy markets, including LNG, NGLs, petroleum products, chemicals, hydrogen, and ammonia. This segment also manufactures and sells specialty, precision-engineered tank products, including geodesic domes, aluminum internal floating roofs, floating suction and skimmer systems, roof drain systems, and floating roof seals. The Utility and Power Infrastructure segment provides construction, maintenance, upgrades, and fabrication services for power generation facilities and power infrastructure system for power generation facilities and power infrastructure systems for various customers, such as public and private utilities, energy producers, and data centers. This segment also offers integrated EPC, fabrication, and upgrade services for LNG peak shaving facilities. The Process and Industrial Facilities segment engages in engineering, construction, maintenance, and repair services across various heavy industrial and energy transition markets comprising midstream and downstream energy, chemicals, mining and minerals, renewable fuels, and hydrogen, as well as involved in engineer and construct specialized infrastructure, and notably thermal vacuum test chambers for the aerospace and defense sectors. Matrix Service Company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Houston, Texas.
business_summary_ko: Matrix Service Company는 미국, 캐나다 및 국제적으로 중요한 에너지 인프라 및 산업 시장을 지원하기 위해 엔지니어링, 제조, 건설 및 유지 관리 서비스를 제공합니다. 저장 및 터미널 솔루션, 유틸리티 및 전력 인프라, 프로세스 및 산업 시설의 세 가지 부문으로 운영됩니다. 저장 및 터미널 솔루션 부문은 LNG, NGL, 석유 제품, 화학 물질, 수소 및 암모니아를 포함한 에너지 시장을 지원하는 액체, 극저온 및 냉장 저장 및 터미널 시설에 대한 엔지니어링, 조달 및 건설(EPC), 수리, 유지 관리 및 제작 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 부문은 또한 측지 돔, 알루미늄 내부 부동 지붕, 부동 흡입 및 스키머 시스템, 지붕 배수 시스템 및 부동 지붕 씰을 포함하여 정밀하게 설계된 특수 탱크 제품을 제조 및 판매합니다. 유틸리티 및 전력 인프라 부문은 공공 및 민간 등 다양한 고객을 위한 발전 시설 및 발전 시설용 전력 인프라 시스템과 전력 인프라 시스템에 대한 건설, 유지보수, 업그레이드 및 제작 서비스를 제공합니다.
